lines.text: The LORD has anointed the speaker to preach good news to the poor and bind up the brokenhearted.
The LORD gives the mourners in Zion a crown of beauty for ashes and the oil of joy for mourning.
The mourners will be called oaks of righteousness, and they will rebuild the ancient ruins.
Strangers will feed the flocks, and God's people will be called the Levites of the LORD.
The LORD loves sacrifice and hates robbery, and He will make an everlasting covenant with His people.
